item.title: Peller announces 19-state Nigeria tour after IShowSpeed snub
item.description: Habeeb ‘Peller’ Hamzat, the content creator, has announced plans to tour 19 states across Nigeria. The popular TikTok streamer shared the itinerary on his Instagram slide, outlining the first leg of his nationwide journey. They include Ibadan (Oyo state), Osun, Ekiti, Ogun, Ondo, Kogi, Kano, Kaduna, Abuja, and Borno. Others are Edo, Port Harcourt (Rivers), Imo, Abia, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Enugu, Niger, and Ebonyi. item.title: Outbreak of deadly Nipah virus in India sparks frantic screenings at Asian airports
item.description: India has confirmed two cases of the deadly Nipah virus, triggering heightened airport screening and surveillance measures in several Asian countries. The cases were detected in late December in West Bengal, eastern India, with health authorities saying both patients are healthcare workers currently receiving treatment at a local hospital.
